title: Deirdre P NDE 3463
content: I was just there. It was as dark as the darkest night. I had a sense of standing before a presence. It was communicated lovingly and firmly that I could do better. Knowledge, compassion and understanding of difficult past events I had been through, were acknowledged, and I was assured that I had never been or never will be alone, not for one moment. Then I rested for some time. It was the most peaceful loving calmness I had ever felt. Then it was time for me to return. I begged and pleaded not to have to return. The love that I felt in those moments, in my eyes, did not exist down here. I argued, wanting to know when I could come back. I was told that things were still going to be difficult for a while and they would get better and then difficult again and then better again. I was told that I would be so happy here that I wouldn't want to leave. I was reassured that I would never be alone and that everything would be okay, to just keep moving forward. And then I was back.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes AccidentDirect head injury 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' Jumped out of truck going sixty-five mph, landed on head.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Darkness | Special Knowledge
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I lost awareness of my body
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal The whole time.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning There was no time, there was no space, and it just was!
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: It was total darkness, I saw nothing, it wasn't a seeing kind of experience.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: There was no sound; it wasn't a listening kind of experience either.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Uncertain I don't know if I would describe it as an 'other being'. I felt like I was in the midst of pure energy.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm If you want to call total darkness a distinctive location, level or dimension, well then, okay. It was if I was in a black hole in the middle of the universe surrounded by nothing but pure energy.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future See narrative.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes That the silly equation that all the scientist are trying to discover, the equation to everything, is the equation to pure energy. And no one is ever going to figure it out because it is so simple.

elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes But I regret it, just like I'm starting to regret filling out this questionnaire, but I am this far, so I might as well finish.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real Confused and uncertain, but I know what I experienced, I was there.
